svg.text: Combined starts with a free choice of updater functions; separated walks the checks in a fixed order first.
Any updater can be chosen as soon as the tick starts.
The available updater narrows as the tick advances.
fall, roll left, roll right, or noop
tick closes after one choice resolves
if possible, open the fall branch
if fall is not taken, open the left
if left roll is not taken, open the
fallback if no roll branch applies
